identity_boundary: Local child process; self-reported clientInfo is never identity or authorization

controls.per_request_protocol_and_capability_vali: Reject missing or unsupported protocolVersion and missing clientCapabilities on every request
controls.pinned_tool_inventory: Expose and dispatch only lookup_policy; reject every other name
controls.issuer_and_token_audience_validation: Not applicable to this credential-free public-training fixture; required before any protected remote deployment
controls.side_effect_approval: Tool has no side effect; any future write requires preview, explicit approval, idempotency, and rollback

audit: Record protocol version, tool name, decision, trace ID, duration, and server version without arguments or result content
disablement: Disable/remove the scoped server entry and verify lookup_policy is absent
removal: Remove configuration and server access, revoke future credentials, verify absence, and retain the review record
residual_risks: Hand-written teaching subset is not a production SDK
A future downstream data source would require object-level authorization
